messages:
sam (Sales): Quick sync: RedwoodHealth procurement sent an OF redline. Two asks: mandatory DocuSign ID check for all signers, and a 99.9% SLA with credits up to 20% monthly. This is a 3-month dedicated POC (~$48k). Thoughts?

nina (Legal): Paste the exact redline blob if you have it. High-level: notarization or very large credit caps are hard for short POCs. We usually limit credits to POC fees and push higher SLAs for longer commits.

sam (Sales): Heres the verbatim from procurement: "Provider shall ensure identity verification via e-sign (DocuSign ID Check) for all signatories. Provider warrants 99.9% uptime; for every 0.1% below, Customer may claim service credits up to 20% of monthly fees."

rohit (Solutions): On the infra side we can enable DocuSign ID Check in the envelope. The dedicated mini-pool can be provisioned in ~4 business days. SLA: small isolated pools have more variance.

jess (Engineering): Agree with Rohit. Our Dedicated contractual SLA historically is 99.5% with standard credits. For hosted multi-tenant we can point to 99.9+ ops metrics but thats not the same as committing at the OF level for a tiny POC. Also need to define "downtime" scope (control vs inference plane).

nina (Legal): Proposed counter: "For Proof-of-Concepts, Provider offers a 99.5% uptime SLA. Service credits for POCs are limited to the aggregate fees paid for the POC term. Provider accepts electronic signatures via DocuSign; DocuSigns identity verification satisfies Providers signer authentication policy. Provider is not responsible for third-party verification failures"

mike (Finance): OK to cap credits to POC fees. If Sales wants negotiation ammo, we can offer a one-time additional credit (e.g., up to $3,600 = 7.5% of POC fees) if Customer signs an annual Dedicated commit within 60 days of POC completion. Need the exact POC fee to compute dollar caps.

sam (Sales): That sounds workable. Procurement will want dollar numbers not percentages. I'll confirm the $48k and ask procurement if the notarization demand is firm.

docsign-bot: Template "POC Order Form" created: tpl_5129. Enable Auth: ID Check for customer signers if requested.

jess (Engineering): Also adding a short SLA carveout: scheduled maintenance, customer-caused outages, and force majeure excluded. Will post suggested wording into the ticket.

sam (Sales): Great. Nina, can you upload the redline counter to the procurement ticket today? Ill draft the DocuSign routing: customer procurement + legal, our AE + Nina. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

nina (Legal): On it. If they push notarization for <$250k, well require escalation and propose a signed addendum, but we wont accept notarization as baseline for this POC.
